## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh includes a structural assertion that Surface is present in the Summary schema block of SKILL.md, and the assertion passes

## TDD Requirement
testing_mode=UPDATE: Modify existing test file to assert new behavior BEFORE SKILL.md is updated. The new test_surface_dimension section will FAIL (RED) against the current SKILL.md (which has no Surface row or bullet).

Given: SKILL.md has no "Surface" row in the probe table or Understanding Summary
When: test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh runs the test_surface_dimension section
Then: assertions for Surface keyword fail (exits non-zero)

## Implementation Steps
1. Add a new test section `=== test_surface_dimension ===` to tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh, following the existing pattern (SECTION="test_surface_dimension", pass()/fail() calls).
2. Within the section, grep SKILL_MD (via brainstorm_aggregate_path — already used by this test file) for:
   a. "| Surface |" (or "Surface" row) in the Phase 1 Step 2 probe table
   b. "Surface:" or "**Surface**:" in the Understanding Summary schema block (the fenced block under Phase 1 Gate Step 1, around lines 172-182)
3. Each grep uses pass() if found, fail() if not found — matching the existing test patterns exactly.
4. Add RED marker to .test-index:
   plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md: tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh [test_surface_dimension]

Note: The test already uses brainstorm_aggregate_path() which combines multiple SKILL.md files. Use the $SKILL_MD variable (set by brainstorm_aggregate_path) for all greps, consistent with existing test sections.

## Files to Modify
- tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh (add test_surface_dimension section)
- .test-index (add RED marker for test_surface_dimension)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(. .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test 2>/dev/null || echo 'bash tests/run-all.sh') && $TEST_CMD 2>/dev/null | tail -5 || true
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] test_surface_dimension section added to test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_surface_dimension' tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh
- [ ] Test FAILS before SKILL.md is updated (RED phase confirmed)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAIL'
- [ ] RED marker added to .test-index
  Verify: grep -q 'test_surface_dimension' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
